label: Protect people and environment
scope_note: Overall radiological safety objective.

label: Radiation effects evidence
scope_note: Biological and epidemiological evidence considered in protection decisions.

label: Stochastic risk
scope_note: Probability of late effects considered in protection.

label: Tissue reactions
scope_note: Effects with dose-related severity above relevant thresholds.

label: Justification
scope_note: Decide whether an activity or individual exposure has sufficient benefit.

label: Optimisation
scope_note: Choose protection reasonably achievable while meeting the intended purpose.

label: Dose limit — occupational and public (principle)
scope_note: Limit exposure of individuals where the protection system applies limits.

label: Planned exposure situation
scope_note: Deliberate introduction or operation of a radiation source.

label: Emergency exposure situation
scope_note: Unexpected situation requiring urgent protective action.

label: Existing exposure situation
scope_note: Exposure already present when a control decision is required.

label: Occupational exposure
scope_note: Exposure incurred by workers in the course of work.

label: Public exposure
scope_note: Exposure of members of the public from a practice.

label: Patient medical exposure
scope_note: Exposure of a patient for diagnosis or treatment.

label: Dose limit — occupational: 20 mSv/year averaged over 5 years; 50 mSv in one year
scope_note: Recommendation or requirement status depends on the source document; Queensland Schedule 5 is the binding local value.

label: Dose limit — occupational: 20 mSv/year averaged over 5 years; 50 mSv in one year (RSPP shorthand)
scope_note: The supplied RSPP says only 20 mSv annually. The complete five-year average and single-year maximum come from Queensland Schedule 5, not the local wording.

label: Dose limit — public: 1 mSv/year
scope_note: Source-scoped value; Queensland Schedule 5 states the binding local limit for other persons.

label: No occupational/public dose limit for intended patient treatment
scope_note: The intended patient dose is controlled through justification and optimisation.

label: Dose constraint
scope_note: Prospective source-related optimisation tool; distinct from a dose limit.

label: Reference level
scope_note: Prospective optimisation tool for emergency or existing exposure.

label: Investigation level
scope_note: Local trigger for review, potentially below a legal limit.

label: ALARA
scope_note: Keep worker and public exposure as low as reasonably achievable, accounting for practical factors; upstream sources often call this optimisation.

label: Time
scope_note: Reduce duration of exposure where feasible.

label: Distance
scope_note: Increase separation from a source where feasible.

label: Shielding
scope_note: Interpose suitable barriers between source and person.

label: Area classification
scope_note: Define controlled, supervised or other areas as appropriate to exposure risk.

label: Access control
scope_note: Restrict entry and source use to appropriate people and conditions.

label: Personal monitoring
scope_note: Measure and assess an individual's occupational exposure.

label: Personal dosimeter
scope_note: Assigned passive or active device used for occupational dose assessment.

label: Personal alarm monitor
scope_note: Device providing immediate warning in specified higher-risk work.

label: Workplace radiation survey
scope_note: Measure area radiation fields or verify premises performance.

label: Exposure record
scope_note: Retained individual monitoring and dose assessment record.

label: Abnormal dose review
scope_note: Investigation of unusual readings or exposure conditions.

label: Pregnant worker
scope_note: Worker who has declared pregnancy; occupational protection context.

label: Dose limit — pregnant worker: 1 mSv for remainder of pregnancy
scope_note: Binding Queensland Regulation ss 52–55 as applicable after awareness of pregnancy; distinct from RSPP pro-rata wording.

label: Dose limit — pregnant worker: 1 mSv (RSPP pro-rata wording)
scope_note: Wording in supplied plan; compare with current Queensland Regulation's 1 mSv for remainder of pregnancy.

label: Pregnant patient
scope_note: Patient for whom treatment or imaging may expose an embryo or fetus.

label: Embryo/fetus dose assessment
scope_note: Estimate exposure and risk for pregnancy-specific decisions.

label: Pregnancy work-duty review
scope_note: Review work conditions to control embryo/fetus exposure.

label: Pregnancy counselling and consent
scope_note: Clinical explanation of risks, benefits and alternatives.

label: Treatment prescription
scope_note: Documented clinical authorisation of intended radiation treatment.

label: Patient identification
scope_note: Confirm the correct patient and treatment data.

label: Treatment plan
scope_note: Approved technical and clinical description of delivery.

label: Calibration and dosimetry
scope_note: Establish and verify source output and delivered dose.

label: Acceptance and commissioning
scope_note: Establish equipment and system performance before clinical use.

label: Quality assurance
scope_note: Planned checks across clinical and technical processes.

label: Independent check
scope_note: Second or independent verification of critical plan or dose data.

label: Data-transfer integrity
scope_note: Ensure prescription, plan and delivery-system data remain consistent.

label: Oncology information management system
scope_note: Safety-critical treatment record and delivery-control system.

label: Formal clinical release
scope_note: Qualified authorisation to resume clinical use after change or fault.

label: Defence in depth
scope_note: Multiple barriers against a single failure causing harm.

label: Incident response
scope_note: Control, report, assess, investigate and learn from unintended exposure or near miss.

label: Incident learning
scope_note: Use events and near misses to improve controls.

label: Regulatory notification
scope_note: Notify the regulator when a statutory reporting threshold is met.

label: Possession licence
scope_note: Queensland permission to possess specified radiation sources.

label: Use licence
scope_note: Queensland permission for an individual to use a source within scope.

label: Approved RSPP
scope_note: Regulator-approved local radiation safety and protection plan.

label: RSPP required content
scope_note: Mandatory classes of measures the plan must address.

label: Possession licensee
scope_note: Organisation holding the Queensland possession licence.

label: Responsible Person (ARPANSA)
scope_note: Person or organisation bearing primary radiation-safety responsibility in the ARPANSA radiotherapy guide; a role analogue, not the Queensland licence definition.

label: Registrant or licensee (IAEA)
scope_note: Authorised party retaining primary responsibility for protection and safety under IAEA GSR Part 3; a role analogue, not a Queensland possession licence.

label: Radiation Safety Officer
scope_note: Qualified person appointed for statutory radiation safety functions.

label: Radiation protection officer (IAEA)
scope_note: IAEA role overseeing occupational and public radiation protection; analogous to, but not identical with, the Queensland statutory RSO.

label: Radiation management / protection programme
scope_note: Documented national or international protection programme; analogous in purpose to parts of the approved RSPP, without sharing its Queensland approval status.

label: Training and competence
scope_note: Personnel understand and can perform assigned roles safely.

label: Controlled local procedure
scope_note: Site-approved operational instruction or work instruction.

label: Implementation record
scope_note: Record demonstrating that a control was carried out.

label: Safety management system
scope_note: Roles, resources, review and records used to manage protection and safety.

label: Source lifecycle
scope_note: Acquisition, possession, use, relocation, supply, transport and disposal.

label: Source security
scope_note: Prevent unauthorised access, removal or malicious use of radioactive sources.

label: Source category
scope_note: Risk/security classification relevant to graded controls.

label: Source inventory and accountancy
scope_note: Knowledge of source identity, status and authorised location.

label: HDR brachytherapy source
scope_note: Sealed radioactive source used in remote afterloading.

label: Radioactive material transport
scope_note: Preparation, consigning, carriage, in-transit storage and receipt.

label: Transport package controls
scope_note: Classification, package, labels, documents and checks.

label: Documented handover
scope_note: Transfer of custody and receipt of a radioactive consignment.

label: Radiotherapy premises design
scope_note: Facility layout, shielding and safety features.

label: Radiation source term
scope_note: Credible output and components used in a shielding calculation.

label: Workload
scope_note: Amount of source use over a defined period.

label: Use factor
scope_note: Fraction of workload directed toward a barrier.

label: Occupancy factor
scope_note: Fraction of time an adjacent area is occupied.

label: Primary, leakage, scatter and neutron components
scope_note: Distinct radiation components considered where relevant in barrier design.

label: Premises weekly dose criterion
scope_note: Queensland Standard section 2.1.1 test for specified accessible area types.

label: Compliant premises
scope_note: Premises meeting applicable Queensland radiation safety standards.

label: Queensland premises standard
scope_note: Standard for premises—ionising radiation sources (2021), given statutory status by the Standards Notice.

label: Certificate of compliance
scope_note: Queensland evidence of an accredited compliance assessment.

label: Radiation warning system
scope_note: Visual or audible indication of source or beam state.

label: Interlock
scope_note: Safety system that prevents or interrupts exposure under specified conditions.

label: Last-person-out control
scope_note: Room clearance step before initiating exposure.

label: Emergency-off control
scope_note: Accessible control to stop exposure or return a source to safety.

label: Additional research exposure
scope_note: Exposure beyond normal clinical management for research.

label: Research participant dose constraint
scope_note: Prospective research and ethics control, scoped to the code's stated applications.

label: Medical physicist dose/risk review
scope_note: Independent assessment or verification for research ethics review.

label: HREC review
scope_note: Ethical review of research justification, risk and consent.

label: Informed consent
scope_note: Participant information and agreement appropriate to the research or clinical decision.

label: National harmonisation
scope_note: Coordination of radiation protection across Australian jurisdictions.

label: Jurisdictional adoption
scope_note: Identified legal mechanism giving an external code local effect.
